title: LLMs Deceive Unintentionally: Emergent Misalignment in Dishonesty from Misaligned Samples to Biased Human-AI Interactions
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLMs on dimensions of honesty and deception, which are core ethical and moral behaviors. It utilizes specific benchmarks like DeceptionBench and BeHonest to assess these traits and includes evaluation examples concerning theological paradoxes like the omnipotence paradox.
